events.text: Checking what's already on disk versus the orchestrator's list.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe commits, remote state, AUDIT marks
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git log --oneline -8 -- app/scripts/probe-t270.mjs | head; echo ---; git branch -r --contains 430a1201 2>&1|head -3; echo ---; git status --short app/scripts/probe-t270.mjs; grep -n "N070\|N067\|N068\|N069\|N080\|N088" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-80 | grep -n "fixed" | head; grep -o "N070.\{0,400\}" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | grep -o "1ef94a2" | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check AUDIT marks and remote containment
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -nE "^\| N0(67|68|69|70|80|88) " /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | awk -F'|' '{print $2, substr($(NF-1),1,90)}'; grep -c 1ef94a2 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md; git branch -r --contains 1ef94a2 | head -2; git log -1 --format=%h origin/main; ls /Users/adithyamurali | grep -i live | head

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l app/scripts/probe-t270.mjs; grep -nE "process.env|BASE|ENTER|admin|consent|yes|route\(|draft" app/scripts/probe-t270.mjs | head -60
